description.value: A rustic forest service recreation site on Sayres Lake reached via an active gravel logging road with a steep, potentially 4WD-required final 2 km; no water on site so riders must carry all they need.

raw_osm.description: A beautiful family orientated forested campsite on the shores of Sayres lake. Sayres has drive-in sites and walk-in sites. There is a limited day-use area, and an area to hand launch your boat, electric motors only.
raw_osm.name: Sayres Lake Recreation Site
raw_osm.operator: Recreation Sites and Trails BC/Greenshades Enterprises

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is live and corroborates OSM tags: power_supply=no and internet_access=no are confirmed by the explicit statement that 'none of the sites have electricity, sewer or any type of water tap' and no running water is available. Reservations are confirmed via the online booking system described on the website. The FAQ specifically flags a steep 2km gravel hill to Sayres Lake on the Florence Lake FSR, which is material context for touring cyclists.
concerns: No phone number in OSM or on website.
Access via Florence Lake Forest Service Road with a steep 2km gravel hill to Sayres Lake; FAQ notes some setups may require 4WD — significant barrier for loaded touring cyclists.
Remote site with no cell service; website notes this explicitly.
Website states firewood supply can sell out; no mention of camping fuel availability.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A legitimate active Recreation Sites and Trails BC campsite, but access requires navigating a steep 2km gravel hill on an active industrial FSR — this may effectively preclude most loaded touring cyclists and warrants human review before inclusion in the WWC directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Wildlife food storage is required per website: all food, garbage, recycling, and coolers must be stored securely in a vehicle or trailer when not in use. Firewood is sometimes sold on-site but availability is not guaranteed.

wow_evidence: steep 2km gravel hill to Sayres Lake on the Florence Lake FSR
